name: openspec-workflow
description: Project-first OpenSpec dashboard for changes, specs, stores, worksets, and safe workflow actions

openspec.focusSidebarViewWhenOpeningChan.description: When opening a change detail in the editor, focus the sidebar on the OpenSpec view.

openspec.focusSidebarViewWhenOpeningDash.description: When running Open Dashboard command, focus the sidebar on the OpenSpec view.

openspec.cliPath.description: OpenSpec CLI executable path. Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH and login shell.

openspec.cliMode.description: OpenSpec CLI runtime source: auto, installed CLI, local OpenSpec source checkout, or custom executable path.

openspec.localOpenSpecSourcePath.description: Path to a local OpenSpec source checkout used when openspec.cliMode is localSource.

openspec.localOpenSpecAutoBuild.description: Whether the extension may offer to build a local OpenSpec source checkout when build output is missing.

openspec.taskExecutionMode.description: When clicking task execute: auto = run via adapter; fillChat = fill chat or copy to clipboard.

openspec.workflowLaunchMode.description: Workflow button behavior: clipboard = copy the generated command; adapter = route through the preferred agent adapter.

openspec.preferredAgentAdapter.description: Preferred Agent executor adapter used when workflowLaunchMode is adapter.

openspec.cursorLaunchMode.description: Cursor adapter launch behavior for non-interactive workflow actions. Verify and Archive use the dedicated Verify & Archive tab; `agentCli` here means headless Agent CLI.
enumDescriptions: Only copy the generated command to the clipboard. Does not open Cursor or start Agent CLI.
Open Cursor through the prompt deeplink with the generated command prefilled. The command is also copied as fallback.
Open Cursor Chat through the VS Code/Cursor chat command query. The command is also copied as fallback.
Run the generated command through Cursor Agent CLI in headless mode. This can modify the workspace and requires Cursor CLI login/trust.
openspec.cursorLaunchMode.markdownDescription:
Cursor adapter launch behavior for workflow actions.

- `clipboard`: safe default; only copy the generated `/opsx:*` command.
- `deeplink`: open Cursor prompt deeplink with `/opsx-*` prefilled, while keeping clipboard fallback.
- `chatCommand`: try Cursor Chat query prefill, while keeping clipboard fallback.
- `agentCli`: run Cursor Agent CLI directly in headless mode; may modify files.

openspec.taskDependencyPolicy.description: When preceding tasks are incomplete: block = prevent execution; warn = show warning and let user proceed.

openspec.cursorAgentModel.description: Cursor Agent CLI model used only for explicit Cursor Agent CLI execution. 'auto' lets Cursor choose.

openspec.agentModel.description: Legacy Cursor agent CLI model setting. Prefer openspec.cursorAgentModel.

openspec.debug.description: Enable debug: show Verify tab in change detail (to test IDE commands), and print the full prompt sent to Cursor Agent in the output channel when executing tasks.
